units.got: Privately placed notes are valued by a matrix method. The Firm determines a spread over the interpolated U.S. Treasury curve equal to the spread of comparable public securities of the same issuer or, where none exist, of comparable issuers with a similar internal rating, sector and maturity, plus an illiquidity premium, plus adjustments for structural features such as financial covenants, make-whole provisions, security and subordination. The note's scheduled cash flows are discounted at the resulting yield.
